sophie_lafleur.name: Dr. Sophie Lafleur
sophie_lafleur.title: Physiotherapist, Founder
sophie_lafleur.bio: Founder of Clinique Aura, Dr. Lafleur has over 12 years of experience in physiotherapy. Passionate about the multidisciplinary approach, she firmly believes that collaboration between professionals is the key to optimal recovery.

marc_andre_tremblay.name: Marc-Andre Tremblay
marc_andre_tremblay.title: Osteopath D.O.
marc_andre_tremblay.bio: A graduate of the College of Osteopathic Studies of Montreal, Marc-Andre practices comprehensive osteopathy integrating structural, visceral and cranial approaches. He treats patients of all ages with particular attention to chronic pain.

camille_bergeron.name: Camille Bergeron
camille_bergeron.title: Registered Massage Therapist
camille_bergeron.bio: Camille has expertise in therapeutic, sports and relaxation massage. Trained in kinesiotherapy and myofascial release techniques, she adapts each session to the specific needs of the patient.

nadia_khoury.name: Nadia Khoury
nadia_khoury.title: Registered Dietitian
nadia_khoury.bio: A member of the Ordre professionnel des dietetistes du Quebec, Nadia helps her patients adopt healthy eating habits. She has a particular interest in anti-inflammatory nutrition and sports performance.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a medical referral?
faq.a1: No, no medical referral is needed to consult in physiotherapy, osteopathy, massage therapy or nutrition. You can book an appointment directly with the professional of your choice.
faq.a2: Most private insurance plans cover physiotherapy, osteopathy, massage therapy and nutrition. We recommend checking your coverage with your insurer. Receipts are issued for each consultation.
faq.q3: How many sessions will I need?
faq.a3: It depends on your condition. During the first consultation, your therapist will establish a treatment plan with an estimate of the recommended number of sessions. On average, 4 to 8 sessions are sufficient for most conditions.
faq.a4: Absolutely! That's the strength of Clinique Aura. Our multidisciplinary approach allows you to combine physiotherapy and massage therapy, osteopathy and nutrition, or any other combination adapted to your needs.
faq.a5: Rates vary by service and duration: physiotherapy ($85-$110/session), osteopathy ($95-$120/session), massage therapy ($65-$120/session), nutrition ($85-$110/session). Contact us for more details.
faq.q6: What happens during a first visit?
faq.a6: The first visit includes a complete assessment of your condition, establishing a diagnosis and a personalized treatment plan. Allow 60 minutes for this first appointment. Bring your insurance card if applicable.

hero.title: About Clinique Aura
hero.subtitle: A holistic vision of health, carried by a passionate team since 2018.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Clinique Aura was born from a simple conviction: the human body functions as a whole. In 2018, Dr. Sophie Lafleur founded the clinic with the ambition of bringing together professionals from different disciplines under one roof to offer truly comprehensive care.
story.p2: Too often, patients navigate between multiple clinics, repeating their story at each consultation. At Clinique Aura, our professionals communicate with each other, coordinate treatments and share a common goal: your optimal recovery.
story.p3: Today, our team of four professionals supports over 2,000 patients per year in a warm and welcoming environment in the heart of Sherbrooke.

wellness.title: Holistic well-being
wellness.description: We believe that health goes beyond the absence of pain. Our approach integrates movement, nutrition and emotional balance for lasting well-being.

excellence.title: Clinical excellence
excellence.description: Our professionals continuously train in the latest advances in their discipline. Every treatment plan is evidence-based and adapted to your reality.

holistic.title: Holistic approach
holistic.description: By bringing four disciplines under one roof, we offer coordinated care that treats the root cause, not just the symptoms.
